text:
The most common yellow fruit that monkeys also eat is the banana.

Regarding the request to identify and label parts of speech in the upcoming text: The provided text is "Whales, the largest mammals on Earth, sing to communicate." Here is the analysis:

*   **Whales**: Noun (Proper/Common Noun acting as the subject)
*   **the**: Article (Definite Article)
*   **largest**: Adjective (Superlative Adjective modifying "mammals")
*   **mammals**: Noun (Common Noun, part of the appositive phrase)
*   **on**: Preposition
*   **Earth**: Noun (Proper Noun, object of the preposition "on")
*   **sing**: Verb (Intransitive Verb, main predicate)
*   **to**: Particle (Part of the infinitive)
*   **communicate**: Verb (Infinitive Verb, functioning as an adverbial of purpose)
